messages:
andrew: Packaging for Private/VPC release 1.4.7 is staged. Images built (+quantized variants), installer tarball ready. Planning transport to airgap bucket during Fri 03:00-04:30 UTC window. Need KMS signer rotation verification before we push.

jia: ack. I ran local verify on the signer key and the new signer id matches rotation plan. Will upload signed submanifest after final checksum.

andrew: thanks. Can you also pin the installer manifest to release-tag `r1.4.7-2026-03` so Dedicated customers see deterministic hashes?

jia: yes pinning now — pushing manifest: `s3://airgap-prod/r1.4.7-2026-03/manifest.json`

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: private-installer -> airgap-bucket at 2026-03-27T03:15:00Z. Canary group: staging-onprem-3. If canary passes, window open for full delivery 03:45-04:15 UTC.

lauren: quick question — rollback tag strategy? If canary fails we should avoid force-replacing the artifact in the bucket. Proposed: publish `r1.4.7-2026-03` + `r1.4.7-rollback` pointing to previous manifest, and update customer docs for rollback steps.

ramon: +1 to not overwrite. Also confirm cosign and cosign key rotation. If a key is rotated we need to include both old and new signatures during the transition period.

jia: cosign signatures attached to the submanifest. Commands I ran:```bash
cosign verify --key ksm://projects/redwood/keys/packaging r1.4.7-2026-03/installer.tar.gz
sha256sum installer.tar.gz > installer.tar.gz.sha256
aws s3 cp installer.tar.gz s3://airgap-prod/r1.4.7-2026-03/
aws s3 cp installer.tar.gz.sha256 s3://airgap-prod/r1.4.7-2026-03/
```

ops-runner-bot: artifact integrity check passed (sha256: 3b8f5d2c9a7e4f1d6a8c2ef9b7f0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b).

lauren: good. For rollback tagging I can prepare an automation script to create `*-rollback` tags and update the deployment guide. I can also add an explicit note in the release notes about KMS key IDs used for this roll (old: kms-key-packaging-v4, new: kms-key-packaging-v5).

andrew: perfect. One more: network transport TTL on the images — we should set short-lived signed URLs for transit (12h) and include checksum manifest in the delivery envelope. Can we ensure the ops transfer team has the envelope?

ramon: I'll hand off the envelope after cosign. Transfer envelope includes: checksums, submanifest, cosign signatures (both keys), and a small script `verify_and_install.sh`. I'll put it in `s3://airgap-prod/handovers/r1.4.7-2026-03/envelope.tar.gz` with artefact ACL restricted to oncall and transfer service account.

jia: uploaded envelope, ACL set. Envelope ETAG: "0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d"

deploy-bot: canary deploy started at 2026-03-27T03:16:00Z (staging-onprem-3). Running smoke tests: installer bootstrap, docker image load, kv-store migrations.

andrew: monitoring dashboard link: https://console.redwood.internal/dashboards/releases/1.4.7 -> watch installer bootstrap and health-checks.

ops-runner-bot: canary smoke tests: bootstrap OK, image load OK, health-check v1 passed, slow step: migrations ~ 18s (expected <15s).

lauren: if migration is slow but successful we still proceed? I'd prefer to hold 15 minutes to ensure no downstream regressions.

andrew: hold for 15. If metrics stable by 03:35 we can continue to full delivery.

ramon: noted. If we abort I'll run the rollback script:```bash
aws s3 cp s3://airgap-prod/r1.4.7-rollback/manifest.json ./
./verify_and_install.sh --manifest manifest.json --dry-run
```

jia: canary stable at 03:33. No errors. Metrics look good.

deploy-bot: canary complete. Rolling full delivery to regions EU/NA/APAC now.

andrew: pushing note to release-notes: https://docs.redwood.internal/releases/1.4.7 (added KMS key ids, rollback instructions, envelope ETAG).

lauren: added rollout TL;DR to #customer-communication.

sophia: FYI security review ok for the rotated key, logged in key-rotation SOP.

andrew: thanks everyone. After delivery I'll open a short followup thread to confirm customer verification and cleanup of temporary signed URLs. :thumbsup:

lauren: :thumbsup:

ramon: :raised_hands:
